StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236 -- no StackType branch). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterDamageReceived.rationale: Right hook in the right slot, and the guards match one for one: `target == base.Owner && dealer != null && props.IsPoweredAttack()` (PersonalHivePower.cs:25) vs powers.py:2388-2393's `target is not self.owner or dealer is None or dealer.side != "player" or not is_powered_attack(props) -> return` -- the sim adding the `dealer.side == "player"` test in place of C#'s implicit `dealer.Player` dereference at PersonalHivePower.cs:34. Note what is deliberately NOT there on either side: an UnblockedDamage check, so the Dazed land even on a fully blocked hit, which is what the sim's docstring says. The killing-blow behaviour is faithful and load-bearing: cmds.py:121 skips the sim's hook when the hit killed the owner and C#'s AfterDamageReceived is skipped by the same CreatureCmd.cs:392 guard -- this exact pair is the SP3 89U act-1 force-win fix (a killing Thrash must NOT fire PersonalHive), so it is pinned by conformance, not just by reading. `base.Amount` Dazed to PileType.Draw at CardPilePosition.Random maps to `CardPileCmd.add_to_draw` x amount. Osty redirection (PersonalHivePower.cs:27-30) is out of Ironclad scope. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: Closed game-wide, re-verified 2026-07-26. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/power_census.py visible` reports 0 IsVisibleInternal overrides of 260 files. That 260 is the .cs files DIRECTLY under src/Core/Models/Powers and EXCLUDES the 16 in Powers/Mocks/ (276 including them); a recursive `grep -rn IsVisibleInternal src/Core/Models/Powers/`, which does cover Mocks/, also returns 0 -- so IsVisible is provably always true for every power in the decompiled game, mocks included. CITATION FIX (2026-07-26 review fix pass): the property lives in src/Core/Models/PowerModel.cs, NOT under Models/Powers/ -- `IsVisible` is the non-virtual property at PowerModel.cs:150-160 and the overridable virtual is `IsVisibleInternal` at PowerModel.cs:167.
